say:1:1029104001:1.text: Thanks for your help. I fear I would've had a hard time handling the Hypofiend if you hadn't been here...
say:1:1029104001:1.source_cn: 感谢各位的帮助。要不是有你们在，光凭我恐怕很难应付这些...

choice_prompt:2:1029104001.text: Thanks for your help. I fear I would've had a hard time handling the Hypofiend if you hadn't been here...
choice_prompt:2:1029104001.source_cn: 感谢各位的帮助。要不是有你们在，光凭我恐怕很难应付这些魔物……

say:3:1029104002:2.text: This is nothing for our magister!
say:3:1029104002:2.source_cn: 嘿嘿，这种程度的魔物，对主人来说根本不算什么！
say:3:1029104002:2.male: This is nothing for our magister!
say:3:1029104002:2.female: This is nothing for our magister!

say:5:1029104003:1.text: Hmph. This Hypofiend must be some lowly lackey who disobeys Lord Syriosus' commands! It even attacked me!
say:5:1029104003:1.source_cn: 哼。此等魔物，一定是不听从赛利欧斯大人命令的下等仆从！...

say:6:1029104004:1.text: Again! No one understands what you're talking about.
say:6:1029104004:1.source_cn: 又、又出现了！这种完全让人摸不着头脑的句子……

say:8:1029104005:1.text: The magister saved you! It's fine if you don't say thanks, but you can't even talk like a normal person!
say:8:1029104005:1.source_cn: 是主人救了你，你不说谢谢也就算了，怎么连人话都不说！
say:8:1029104005:1.male: The magister saved you! It's fine if you don't say thanks, but you can't even talk like a normal person!
say:8:1029104005:1.female: The magister saved you! It's fine if you don't say thanks, but you can't even talk like a normal person!

say:10:1029104006:1.text: Only Lord Syriosus will ever have my respect. You are far from worthy.
say:10:1029104006:1.source_cn: 吾之敬意，永远只朝向赛利欧斯大人。汝等尚未够格。

say:11:1029104007:1.text: Should'st we one day tumble together into the abyss... Then I shall give thee deserved respect.
say:11:1029104007:1.source_cn: 若有朝一日，汝等与吾同坠深渊……届时，吾将赐予汝等应有...

choice_prompt:12:1029104007.text: Should'st we one day tumble together into the abyss... Then I shall give thee deserved respect.
choice_prompt:12:1029104007.source_cn: 若有朝一日，汝等与吾同坠深渊……届时，吾将赐予汝等应有的尊敬。

say:13:1029104008:1.text: Where I am, there be mine intention. Wherefore do I divulge such to you mortals?
say:13:1029104008:1.source_cn: 吾身处此地，自有吾的意图所在。而吾之意图，为何要与汝等...

say:15:1029104011:1.text: Oh, come on! I swear there's no reasoning with her.
say:15:1029104011:1.source_cn: 呜哇……感觉完全没办法和她沟通……

say:17:1029104012:2.text: Well... Actually, it's like this—I found this girl wandering around all alone, looking very suspicious.
say:17:1029104012:2.source_cn: 那个……其实事情是这样的，不久之前，我发现这个小女孩孤...

say:18:1029104013:1.text: I tried talking with her, but as you can see, I can't make heads or tails of what she's saying.
say:18:1029104013:1.source_cn: 我试图和她搭话，结果就像你们看到的一样，根本听不懂她在...

say:19:1029104014:1.text: So I just watched and waited a while... and I realized she wanted to investigate that evil rift.
say:19:1029104014:1.source_cn: 于是我就在她旁边观察了一番……这才知道她是想要调查那个...

say:20:1029104015:1.text: But that's so dangerous! A Hypofiend can emerge at any time, like you just saw.
say:20:1029104015:1.source_cn: 但这实在太危险了！这块区域时不时会冒出来一些魔物，就像...

say:21:1029104016:1.text: I have a request. I'm sorry if it's a bit forward, but there really isn't anyone else around who I could ask...
say:21:1029104016:1.source_cn: 那个……我有一个请求，可能有些失礼，但这附近也实在没有...

choice_prompt:22:1029104016.text: I have a request. I'm sorry if it's a bit forward, but there really isn't anyone else around who I could ask...
choice_prompt:22:1029104016.source_cn: 那个……我有一个请求，可能有些失礼，但这附近也实在没有其他人可以求助了……

say:23:1029104017:1.text: If it's not too much bother, could you help escort this girl back?
say:23:1029104017:1.source_cn: 如果您方便的话……可以帮忙护送这个女孩带回去吗？
say:23:1029104017:1.male: If it's not too much bother, could you help escort this girl back?
say:23:1029104017:1.female: If it's not too much bother, could you help escort this girl back?

say:24:1029104018:1.text: She let slip that she's from Holistone. It would be a great relief if you could return her to the village.
say:24:1029104018:1.source_cn: 之前她透露过自己是圣石镇的居民，如果你们能把她送回镇子...

choice_prompt:25:1029104018.text: She let slip that she's from Holistone. It would be a great relief if you could return her to the village.
choice_prompt:25:1029104018.source_cn: 之前她透露过自己是圣石镇的居民，如果你们能把她送回镇子上就太好了。

say:26:1029104019:1.text: You can trust Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We'll definitely bring her back safe and sound.
say:26:1029104019:1.male: You can trust Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We'll definitely bring her back safe and sound.
say:26:1029104019:1.female: You can trust Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>! We'll definitely bring her back safe and sound.

say:30:1029104021:2.text: I am kin of Lord Syriosus. What can ye mortals do to me?
say:30:1029104021:2.source_cn: 吾乃赛利欧斯大人的眷属，汝等凡人能奈我何？

say:31:1029104022:1.text: Now's the time to be quiet! We'll get you safely home no matter what, even if we have to do it by force!
say:31:1029104022:1.source_cn: 这种时候你就别说话啦！反正不管怎么样，我们都会把你好好...

say:32:1029104023:1.text: Th-thou... Hmph. How vulgar to speak of force!
say:32:1029104023:1.source_cn: 汝、汝等……哼，以武力论事，庸俗！

choice:22:1:2.text: Sure, if it's not too time-consuming.
choice:22:1:2.male: Sure, if it's not too time-consuming.
choice:22:1:2.female: Sure, if it's not too time-consuming.

choice:12:0:1.text: Anyway, what are you doing here?
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 所以，你为什么会在这里？
choice:12:0:1.male: Anyway, what are you doing here?
choice:12:0:1.female: Anyway, what are you doing here?

say:34:1029104009:1.text: Purpose? All I have is with Lord Syriosus, and my purpose is to mirror his.
say:34:1029104009:1.source_cn: 吾的目的？吾的一切均与赛利欧斯大人同在，吾之目的，即为...

say:35:1029104010:1.text: Canst ye mortals even comprehend Lord Syriosus' purpose?
say:35:1029104010:1.source_cn: 赛利欧斯大人之意图，岂是汝等凡人得以知悉之物？
